records.suggestedScope: Explicit report/capture and every non-cache diagnostic/export file (including actual report attachment paths). Do not stage the parent output directory or any .playwright-artifacts cache; do not delete or move the cache as part of this read-only task.

limitations: Inventory of existing local bytes/report paths only. No staging, movement, deletion, Git action, browser or tests executed; failed runs remain failed.

runner.note: Runner historical defaults remain r2; pass both r3 paths explicitly. Existing successful capture reuse is checked again by the final binder.

retentionSafety.limits: Dependency/current-byte audit only; no new runner/browser/test result. Shell changes still require fresh actual shell and group04 captures.

strictSuggestedStageScope: Only rawreports/captures, exactly actual rawreport file attachments, and .last-run metadata. Unreferenced caches and any other unreferenced diagnostics remain unstaged for later review.
